resources.string: Manage Tailscale installation, updates and removal on the connected Linux or Windows host.

Enable the Tailscale Inc. stable signed repository at https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/ for the connected host distribution. Signing key fingerprint: 2596 A99E AAB3 3821 893C 0A79 458C A832 957F 5868. Conflicting existing sources or keys are refused. This step refreshes indexes without installing software.
Refresh the package indexes of sources already authorized on the connected host. This does not install software or change trust.

Use the original installation transaction to stop the owned service or acknowledge the inspected state. Stopping the service may interrupt remote access. Closing does not turn the original operation into a success.
This changes the connected host network service and may interrupt remote access. Uninstall retains login and configuration data.
